description:
A desktop terminal for running multiple CLI agents in parallel sessions.

PATerminal provides parallel terminal sessions, split panes, session resume,
agent status, and Git tools for CLI agent workflows on Windows and macOS.
CLI agents must be installed and authenticated separately.
Official builds include a 30-day trial of all features. Advanced features
require a license after the trial. The source is available under a proprietary license.
Changes
- Diff button in the pane bar. A new Diff button sits immediately left of Worktree in each pane's Git controls. It opens the uncommitted changes of that pane's folder in the diff overlay (the same content as the Git window's "All changes") without opening the Git window. It is disabled when there are no changes. In narrow panes it collapses to its icon and stays visible when Worktree and Fetch are hidden.
- Resizable diff overlay and Git window. Drag the right edge, bottom edge or bottom-right corner of the Git window or a multi-file diff overlay to resize it; it stays centred. The file list of a multi-file diff and the Git window's sidebar can also be resized by dragging their edge. Double-click a handle to restore the default. Sizes are remembered across restarts.
- The diff overlay no longer closes on an outside click. Only × and Escape close it. The Git window still closes when you click outside it.
- Long lines wrap inside the diff overlay instead of scrolling sideways. Diffs shown inside the Git window keep horizontal scrolling. The file list of a multi-file diff is also narrower by default.
- Sidebar notes show up to three lines. Line breaks are kept and long notes wrap, with … beyond three lines (the tooltip shows the full text). Short or empty notes stay on one line, so sessions without a note keep their height.
- Larger note editor. The note editor opens about three times wider than before and 360px tall. It is still limited to the window size and can be resized.
macOS Universal and Windows x64 installers are attached by the release workflow. This release becomes Latest after the build and updater signature checks succeed.
